Transaction Log
rows.text: The terminal shall keep an append-only transaction log sufficient to reconcile a shift.

rows.name: Contactless Time
rows.text: The terminal shall complete a contactless payment of 100 or less within 2 seconds of card presentation.

rows.name: Offline Floor Limit
rows.text: When the acquirer link is unavailable the terminal shall store transactions up to a configured floor limit and forward them when the link returns.

rows.name: Card Data Protection
rows.text: The terminal shall not store card primary account numbers outside the secure element, and shall render stored keys unusable on tamper detection.

rows.name: PIN Privacy
rows.text: The keypad shall encrypt the PIN within the secure element and never expose it to the terminal application.

rows.name: Receipt
rows.text: The terminal shall print a receipt showing the basket, the amount tendered and the approval code for every approved payment.
